svg.title: Proposition 20 finite-sample residual certification
svg.desc: A theorem map from the P19 population screening-off condition through IID categorical samples, a Hoeffding total-variation radius, entropy continuity, and a finite-sample confidence interval for conditional mutual information.
svg.text: P20 - Finite-Sample Residual Certification
Turn the P19 population screening-off condition into an explicit finite-data confidence certificate.
P19 POPULATION TARGET
I(E; Ω | T) = 0
Screening-off by the declared physical descriptor T.
FINITE DATA
(Ωᵢ, Tᵢ, Eᵢ), i = 1,…,n
IID categorical observations on declared finite alphabets.
EMPIRICAL RESIDUAL
Îₙ = I(P̂ₙ; E, Ω | T)
Plug-in conditional mutual information in nats.
P20A · Joint-distribution concentration
M = dΩ dT dE
Cellwise Hoeffding bounds plus a union bound control joint total variation.
With probability at least 1−α: TV(P̂ₙ,P) ≤ τₙ(α).
P20B · Continuity transfer to conditional information
c_d(r) = h₂(r)+r log(d−1), below its uniform threshold
ΔCMI(r) = min{Imax, cET(r)+cΩT(r)+cT(r)+cEΩT(r)}
Marginal TV contraction and finite-alphabet entropy continuity propagate error.
The bound is capped by Imax = min{log dΩ, log dE}.
P20C · Finite-sample confidence interval
| I(E;Ω | T) − Îₙ | ≤ ΔCMI(τₙ(α))
Lₙ = max{0, Îₙ−ΔCMI(τₙ)} Uₙ = min{Imax, Îₙ+ΔCMI(τₙ)}
The interval [Lₙ,Uₙ] covers the population residual with probability at least 1−α.
CERTIFIED DECISION
Lₙ > 0 ⇒ the declared T fails the P19 screening-off condition at confidence 1−α.
Interpret descriptor insufficiency first: omitted physics, measurement error, boundaries, timescale, or sampling assumptions remain live alternatives.
